key_facts: NOV reported revenues of $1.25 billion and a net loss of $115 million for the first quarter of 2021 on a U.S. GAAP basis.

NOV's consolidated revenue fell $78 million or 6% sequentially to $1.25 billion during the first quarter of 2021 due to ongoing austerity from customers, operational disruptions from severe weather and COVID-19 challenges.
